fieldValues.title: Driving work: terminal loop first, coordination ranked first, daily review and weekly session
fieldValues.decision_question: How does the owner start driving work across the repositories, and what comes first?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (plan: driving work, the tools and the loop; srs-programme#97, clerk#38, clerk#39); awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Surface: the srs-web editor first. Objective: rank 3, or no objective until the problems are synthesised. Cadence: weekly only, or on demand.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Drive the work from the terminal clerk session first, using what exists (the clerk agenda, /session, roadmap, queue and claim). The srs-web owner slices (#548, #562, #544, #560) replace it piece by piece. A Programme coordination objective, Keep work moving to done, is ranked 1 in Focus 1, because it enables everything else; writing moves to rank 2 and memory to rank 3. The owner runs a daily review of about ten minutes and a weekly session to ratify, affirm, rank and read the indicators. New tools: a stalled-work section in the daily agenda and a synthesiser standing job.
fieldValues.next_steps: srs-programme#97 (objective), clerk#38 (stalled work), clerk#39 (synthesiser), clerk#35, clerk#25.
